instruction: Create a new LibreOffice Writer document, import the .xcf image located on the Desktop, and save it to the Desktop as 'picture.odt'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires inserting the .xcf image into LibreOffice Writer and saving as picture.odt. The evaluator checks if the ODT file exists and contains at least one embedded image. Custom getter extracts the ODT file and counts embedded images.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator provides complete coverage of all instruction requirements: file existence and image embedding
Getter logic is correct: properly retrieves ODT file from VM, parses it as ZIP archive, and counts images in Pictures/ directory (standard ODT structure)
Metric comparison logic is correct: verifies both file existence (50%) and image count >= minimum (50%)
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts the right state (ODT file + image count), metric compares the right aspects
Expected values are semantically correct: has_image=true and min_image_count=1 properly verify that at least one image is embedded
Postconfig is appropriate: activates window and saves file to ensure ODT is flushed to disk before verification
Edge cases are handled: missing file returns file_exists=False, ZIP reading errors are caught, temp files are properly cleaned up
Implementation is robust: uses proper ODT parsing (ZIP-based), handles None values, includes proper error logging
